items.title: Biogen (BIIB) Stock Price Tracks Q3 Results Through Loss And Cash Flow
items.summary: Biogen shareholders woke up to a pullback. The stock closed at US$244.05, down 3.4% from the prior session, even though Q3 2026 revenue reached US$2.8b with double digit year on year growth and free cash flow hit US$600m. That gap between a weak price tape and an earnings print weighed down by a reported loss of US$20.6m is where your decision lives. The market is trading the headline loss.
